description: This file defines the CustomField class in the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for retrieving custom field data from the database, including individual custom fields and collections based on customer groups.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: A model class for managing custom fields in Opencart, providing methods to retrieve custom field data from the database.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves multiple custom fields, optionally filtered by customer group ID, including associated values for select, radio, and checkbox types.
